tolerance.notes: Point cell-averaging regridder (RFC pure-io-data-loaders §8: 'Point: cell mean of contributing stations; the configured missing_value for cells with no station'). golden is the ANALYTIC oracle: per cell, the arithmetic mean of the stations sharing its integer spatial bin, or the configured missing_value when no station shares the bin. The broad-phase bin-Skolem assignment is materialised by the ESS value-invention front-door (AbstractDict path), so the reference binding (Julia, through the ESS engine) is the evaluating binding; cross-binding is documented in tests/conformance/regridding/README.md (the integer bin-Skolem candidate set is byte-identical per CONFORMANCE_SPEC §5.5, but the front-door materialisation is engine-bound).

notes: dx=dy=1: station bins (floor(lon),floor(lat)) — station 1 (0.3,0.5)->bin(0,0), station 2 (0.7,0.2)->bin(0,0), station 3 (1.5,0.5)->bin(1,0); cell bins — cell 1 (0,0)->bin(0,0), cell 2 (1,0)->bin(1,0), cell 3 (2,0)->bin(2,0). So cell 1 gets stations {1,2} (mean 15), cell 2 gets {3} (mean 30), cell 3 gets none (missing_value).
